sources.snippet: The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B).

sources.title: Qwen3-Embedding-8B — Doubleword | Multilingual Embedding Model
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for advanced text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, the 8B variant inherits exceptional multilingual capabilities, long-text understanding, and reasoning skills.
